g.text: The Uno input uses its internal pull-up. This wiring applies to an open-collector output; confirm output type, polarity and voltage before connecting.

g.desc: The Uno input uses its internal pull-up. This wiring applies to an open-collector output; confirm output type, polarity and voltage before connecting.

g.text: ERC and exact-net checks validate this pin map, not a specific reflective sensor board or detection range.

g.desc: ERC and exact-net checks validate this pin map, not a specific reflective sensor board or detection range.

g.text: J1 is a logical module connector: 1=module supply, 2=GND, 3=DO, 4=AO (if fitted). DO connects to Uno D2; AO is unused by Lab 34.

g.desc: J1 is a logical module connector: 1=module supply, 2=GND, 3=DO, 4=AO (if fitted). DO connects to Uno D2; AO is unused by Lab 34.

g.text: J1 pin 1 is intentionally left unconnected in this schematic because reflective sensor breakouts differ in supply range and regulator design. Connect it only after checking the exact module documentation.
